refit.after: 00b411e (4130de3 adds the Docker-host memory gate, which leaves this host overlapping)

command: refit run --config <run.json> --output <new directory> --quiet --json; cold with an empty REFIT_DEPENDENCY_CACHE_DIRECTORY, warm reusing it; one repository per Docker lock hold
fields: seconds is wall-clock for the whole run; timings are validation.timings in milliseconds (overlapping stages each count their own time); memory is the peak docker stats usage per sandbox kind and the peak sum across sandboxes running at once (after only); probe times sandbox start, source copy and dependency archive extraction on the repository own archive
